verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted and documented as built to run entirely offline, including an air-gapped mode with complete network isolation, so data used with local models never reaches a third party that could train on it. It has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out control, and when cloud providers are connected, whether data is used for training depends on those providers. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for training, a per-provider training opt-out control, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
No AI key, no account with anyone, no cloud.
